## Concept
Bloomberg-style scrolling ticker tape across the app header — always visible, always updating. Not a widget you need to open — ambient awareness.

## Data Sources (left to right)

### 1. Session Status
- London 🇬🇧 open · NY 🇺🇸 open · Tokyo 🇯🇵 closed
- Next session opening in: 2h 15m (Tokyo)
- Color-coded: green=open, amber=closing soon, grey=closed

### 2. Upcoming High-Impact Events
- FOMC Minutes in 2h 30m
- NFP tomorrow 08:30
- AAPL earnings Jul 24
- Sourced from TimelineService /api/automation/timeline

### 3. Provider Health Dot
- 🟢 Finnhub · 🟢 MT5 · 🟡 Alpha Vantage (slow) · 🔴 Polygon (down)
- Sourced from ProviderHealth table

### 4. Watchlist Top Movers
- XAUUSD ↑1.2% · NVDA ↓0.8% · EURUSD ↑0.3%
- Sourced from real-time quotes (MT5 bridge)

### 5. Automation Pulse
- 3 strategies active · 12 positions · 0 alerts · Last tick: 3s ago
- Sourced from AutomationConfig + LoopTick

## Implementation
- Extend existing \TickerBar\ component or build new \MarketTape\ component
- Scrolling animation (CSS marquee or requestAnimationFrame)
- Fixed to top of viewport below header
- Each section separated by · or |
- Click section → navigate to relevant area (click session → timeline, click mover → symbol detail)

## Phase
Phase 1 — core market awareness. No trading decisions from this, just situational awareness.
